answer: Split every identity's signing key into five shares held by unrelated guardians: no trade clears without 3-of-5 co-signatures. Guardians earn 1 unit per co-sign and lose a 20-unit bond if they bless fraud, so a fake must corrupt three strangers per identity. Like timber cut from a shared forest, one fake is a relic nobody trusts, while honest trades spiral through five independent witnesses. Running 100 fakes means bribing 300 guardians and risking 6,000 units in slashed bonds.
